summary: Frontend-only E2E + visual QA of the grey 'Lumen' redesign at 1920, 1280 and 390. Home loader→hero, NDA chip, h1 (no mid-word breaks at 390: lines 'Direction'/'Before'/'Execution.'), hero-start/hero-book/nav-cta scroll to #contact, orb sits below the buttons without overlapping them (desktop and mobile). Glass pill nav: all 6 links route correctly and the active pill follows the current page. nav-cta from a subpage goes home and scrolls to contact. nav-cta is hidden on mobile. The mobile drawer opens, nav-m-* links route and close it, nav-m-cta scrolls to contact, and body overflow is reset. Home section order is correct (hero, marquee with 'Built-in NDA', nda-section with 3 tiles + learn-more→/nda, journey with 5 steps →/services/<slug> + arcs that draw on scroll on desktop and cards on mobile, philosophy, insights 0..2 + insights-all, faq-0..3 + more-questions, CTA, contact + nda note, footer). Contact form: empty submit shows a validation toast. ONE real submission with qa+30@example.com returned 200, the form cleared, and the backend log confirms the admin email and auto-reply were sent. /services: h1 'The Service Ecosystem', hovering service-01..05 swaps service-panel, the active service-more link is correct, and the journey section renders below. /nda: h1, 6 covers, 4 steps, promises, and nda-start → /#contact scrolls to contact. /about (manifesto + values rose), /insights (8 cards), /faq (17 items, accordion works) and /services/business-blueprint (no Flagship badge) all render in grey. A computed-colour scan found no warm (orange/gold/brass) colours on any page. There were no JS page errors. One bug was found and fixed: /about overflowed horizontally at 390.

minor.issue: Backend log: 'Database persistence skipped: Connect call failed 127.0.0.1:5432' (it tries Postgres, which is not available). Emails still send, but leads are not stored. The platform standard is MongoDB via MONGO_URL. Not tested in depth (frontend-only scope).

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: the rotating square rose expanded the page to scrollWidth 414 at 390 (horizontal scroll). The Page wrapper lacked the overflowX: clip that Home has. Added style={{overflowX:'clip'}} to Page in App.js; re-verified as 390.

Step 05's vertical label 'Investment preparation' is too long for the column. Gap to the number badge is 0px at both 1280 and 1920. The '5' badge gets squashed into a pill shape, and the '(raise)' tag + arrow are pushed ~30px lower than steps 1-4 (misaligned baseline). Step 03 'Brand architecture' also has only a 9px gap at 1280. Fix: clamp the label font-size (e.g. min(2.1vw, …)), add shrink-0 to the badge, or abbreviate to 'Investment prep'.
On nested routes (/services/business-blueprint, /insights/<slug>) no nav pill is active, because the check is strict equality l.href === pathname. Use pathname.startsWith(l.href) for non-root links.

issues: The 'Execution-ready' floating chip (x 62%, y 80%) slightly overlaps the right edge of the orb on mobile; the 'NDA Secured' chip sits ~10px under the Book Strategy Call button. Consider moving the mobile chips lower or hiding them under md.
Header micro-labels 'CONFIDENTIAL BY DEFAULT' / 'SYMSTRUO × FOUNDERS' each wrap onto 2 lines; hide one on mobile or stack them.

Leftovers from the old design: the About page LinkedIn button, the home FAQ 'more-questions' button, the service-detail 'START BUILDING' CTA and next-service/next-insight cards use the old square btn-ghost / sharp-border style and still reference var(--brass), while the new system uses rounded pill-light/pill-dark and glass cards. Unify them to the pill/lumen-card styles.
Tagline 'Direction · Clarity · Conviction · Precision' wraps so that a line starts with '·'; use nowrap per item or a line break.
The fixed ScrollCompass (BRG xxx°, bottom-right) overlaps the journey card's bottom-right corner near 'Explore all services'; minor.

action_items: Fix Journey desktop step-05 (and step-03 at 1280) label/badge collision and the misaligned tag baseline
Make the nav active pill match nested routes (startsWith)
Unify leftover square btn-ghost buttons / brass-named vars with the new pill + glass style
Tidy mobile hero chip positions vs the orb and the NDA header wrap
(Backend, optional) Contact leads are not persisted: the backend tries Postgres :5432; switch to MongoDB via MONGO_URL if persistence is wanted
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 873 lines; split pages (Home, ServicesPage, NdaPage, AboutPage, FAQ, Contact, Footer, ServiceDetail) into /pages and /components files
Nav.jsx active check uses strict equality; nested routes get no highlight
CSS var names --brass/--brass-dim now hold grey values; rename to --silver to avoid confusion
Home hash scroll (/#contact) fires 200ms after mount while the 2s loader is running; it works now, but it is fragile if the layout shifts after load. Consider re-scrolling once loaded=true
seed_data_creation: One contact submission (name TEST_QA Lumen, qa+30@example.com) was sent; real emails were delivered. No DB records (persistence is skipped by the backend).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Grey Lumen design. The custom cursor ring is on non-touch devices, so use JS click. Lenis smooth scroll is active; programmatic window.scrollTo works. service-more-0N exists only for the active panel (default active = 02). Do not submit the contact form more than once (real emails). The /about overflow fix is in Page wrapper in App.js.
